header: From one freight contract to three studios
subheadline: Ten years in short: what we took on and what it taught us. Dates show when the work shipped, not when the contract was signed.

events.title: The studio starts with one client
events.description: Ana Marques and Tomás Ferreira redraw the Northwind Logistics dispatch board in nine weeks, from a rented desk in Lisbon.

events.title: Research becomes its own practice
events.description: Inês Duarte joins to run field studies. Since then, every project starts with two weeks of interviews before any design work.

events.title: Copenhagen and the first health project
events.description: Henrik Bech opens the third studio, and Atlas takes on its first regulated medical product: the Vireo Health patient portal.
